title: Recognized at Ingenious+
subtitle: Ontario regional award · H₂@Home
paragraphs: Our work on H₂@Home was recognized through Ingenious+, a Canadian youth innovation challenge.
I travelled to Toronto for the Ontario regional awards ceremony, where we met other young innovators working on sustainability, technology, and community-focused ideas.

Our project received a $1,000 award to support further development. It was encouraging to see something that started as an engineering competition project recognized beyond university, and to hear what other people were working on.
